Travel into the [[Catacombs]] to place candles on four stands to commemorate the brave warriors who sacrificed their lives defending [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|Ascalon]].

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Light candles on all four [[Remembrance Brazier|braziers]] in the catacombs to appease the angry spirits.
* [0..4]/4 candles placed.
* Return to [[Necromancer Munne]] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Grim Cesta (gauntlet)|Grim Cesta]]
** [[Energy]] +3
** [[Armor rating|Armor]] +5 (vs. [[physical damage]])
** Armor +5 (while attacking)

===Environmental changes===
* Upon completing the quest, the braziers will no longer spawn. Neither will the [[Restless Spirit (pre-Searing)|Restless Spirits]], resulting in a higher presence of [[Restless Corpse]]s in the swamp water, as they will no longer be thinned out by the spirits.

==Walkthrough==
Talk to Necromancer Munne and take the 4 [[Votive Candle (pre-Searing)|Votive Candles]]. Proceed through the Catacombs and place a candle on each of the four [[Remembrance Brazier]]s in the order shown on the mission map.

Since some of the braziers are located in [[Swamp Water]], which causes constant health degeneration, you need to monitor your health drop. Be careful about drawing [[aggro]] from nearby foes at the same time.

===Skill recommendations===
* Any healing skill, such as [[Orison of Healing]] or [[Troll Unguent]], to counter with the swamp water effects.
:* [[Life stealing]] skills like [[Vampiric Touch]] can be useful too, though there are few foes to use them against in the swamp water.

==Interactive objects==
* [[Remembrance Brazier]]

==NPCs==
===Allies===
* {{w}} 10 [[Restless Spirit (pre-Searing)]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Necromancer Munne
:''"The dead are restless. Buried here are many brave warriors who sacrificed their lives defending Ascalon from foreign guilds from the south and the bestial Charr to the north. They wonder if it is not too much that their sacrifices be remembered and honored.''

:''"Someone must place '''candles''' on the '''four stands''' commemorating their actions so they will know we have not forgotten them."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = As you wish.
| decline = I'd rather not.
| ask = Take a '''candle''' to each '''brazier''', so that the spirits of the dead will know we remember their deeds.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Necromancer Munne
:''"Appeasing the spirits wasn't so difficult after all, was it? Learning to understand the dead is the first step in understanding the art of the Necromancer."''

==Notes==
* If you die, you will lose the candles.  Just go back to Necromancer Munne for more candles.  She will take any extra back when you go to get your reward.
